fields.name: buttonNew

fields.name: buttonNext

fields.name: buttonSave

fields.name: buttonDone

fields.name: taxAuthorityName

fields.sourceQuote: Type a unique name (generally the country name) for the tax authority.

fields.name: taxAuthorityCountry

fields.name: taxRateTypeName

fields.name: taxRateTypeCalculationMethod

fields.name: taxRateRateType

fields.name: taxRateEffectiveDate

fields.notes: Add Tax Rate Configuration window.

fields.name: taxRatePercent

compressedRanges.label: tax code fields (1-4)
compressedRanges.expandsTo: One reading of the Tax Code tab's downstream effect names 4 VAT tax code fields (Tax Code 1 through Tax Code 4) that become selectable lists once a tax code is predefined; the contradicting reading (step-7) names only a single 'VAT Tax Code 1' field. Both readings are recorded in contradictions rather than reconciled; the underlying VAT Tax Code 1-4 field range itself belongs to the Forms and Fields page (already built) per available-vat-fields-8b395ce2.md, not to this page.

notes: Tax Administration is the richest of the four pages: 5 tabs (Tax Authorities, Expense Type Groups/Expense Types Group - label drift, Vendor Groups, Tax Code, Tax Validation), a 3-step New Tax Authority wizard, and two nearly-identical 3-step group wizards (Expense Type Group, Vendor Group) that differ in one control (Vendor Groups adds a non-enumerated Tax Type example-list on its Vendor Name step; Expense Type Groups has no counterpart). Two field tables (Calculation Method, Tax Validation Type) enumerate exactly ONE documented value each and are recorded as such, not padded with an invented alternative. 'withholding' tax returns zero hits anywhere in the corpus - not documented, not invented here. The 'exempt, standard, or reduced' rate-type wording in tax-administration-tool-0f5fff3c.md and the 'Standard or Reduced' wording in step-4 are both flagged as EXAMPLES ('for example') rather than an enumerated Tax Rate Type Name value set, per the no-examples rule. Six verbatim contradictions are recorded (tab label, menu-link name, role name, role-assignment nav path, Tax Validation field labels, and predefined-tax-code result wording) - none reconciled. Several must-read files were deliberately NOT re-emitted as fields here because the procedure text itself names a different tool/page as their home (Forms and Fields for VAT field catalogs and the Specify Tax feature; the end-user Invoice page for Switch Tax Mode; SAP Concur support/a third-party contract for Digital Tax Invoice Validation) - see mustReadSkipped for each. Country-support scope (supported-countries-for-vat vs. the Canada/UK-US-Japan-Australia tools-guides topics) is likewise recorded as inventory-level context rather than as a page control, since no admin field on this page selects or restricts country support - that is a fixed product/provisioning fact, not something a human configures via a button or list here.

mustReadSkipped.why: Forms-and-Fields form-field catalog (VAT Amount/Rate/Tax Code 1-4, etc.) already built on that page; re-homing it here would duplicate fields across pages. Cited only via dependencyCandidates/notes, not re-emitted as a field of Tax Administration.
Prorated VAT field catalog is a Forms-and-Fields/extract artifact, not a Tax Administration page control.
VAT label catalog lives on the Payment Request Line Item Details form (Forms and Fields), not this page.
Names which countries VAT calculation supports; this is product-scope context, not an admin control with a UI field/button on the Tax Administration page. No procedure names a control here.

Describes how Canada VAT maps to the VAT Amount 1-4 fields on the invoice form (Forms and Fields territory), and directly contradicts the admin-guides claim that Canada is unsupported - recorded as scope context, not a page control.
Same as canada-de22c9f9.md: VAT field usage guidance for these countries, not a Tax Administration page control.
States the corpus defers other-country VAT setup to the Account Manager and an external VAT Setup Guide not in this corpus - confirms thinness, documents no control on this page.

The Switch Tax Mode button lives on the end-user Invoice entry page ('a Switch Tax Mode button appears on the Invoice page, and end-users can click it'), not on the admin Tax Administration page. Out of scope for this page under END-USER vs ADMIN.

Explicitly locates the Specify Tax in Invoice Details or Itemization Summary feature's activation on the Forms and Fields tool ('administrators can go to the Forms and Fields tool to activate'), not the Tax Administration page.
Same feature as control-tax-amount-handling-8540cd38.md; its 11-step activation procedure runs on the Forms and Fields tool, not this page.
